note: The human release gate for hicksconsulting.org. An item in data/admin/content_manifest.json publishes only when its id appears here with a real approvedBy. status:'approved' in the manifest means a machine validated it, not that anyone agreed to publish it - scripts/autonomy/run_cycle.mjs writes that status itself, so before this file existed the daily Content Publish cron released LLM-drafted pages to a client's live site with nobody in the loop. 113 such items were queued one per day into the future.
how_to_approve: node scripts/admin/approve_publication.mjs --id <manifest id> --by "<person>" [--note "<why>"]. Reachable only through the Admin Operations workflow_dispatch, never from a cron.

pre_gate_baseline.note: 59 items were already live when this gate was introduced. They are not retired and not retroactively approved; the gate governs future releases only. Everything still unpublished needs an approval here, whatever its manifest status says.
